newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: IHC Caland reiterates '97 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: IHC Caland reiterates '97 profit forecast.

text.p: Shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Monday its forecast of higher profits in 1997 was unaffected by expectations of lower profits at its fully-owned shipbuilding subsidiary IHC Holland.

"In order to avoid any misunderstanding, IHC Caland would like to confirm that (it) has taken into account these expectations of lower results at IHC Holland in its April 1997 forecast of (full-year) 1997 profits of some 110 million guilders," IHC Caland said in a statement.
"Consequently this prognosis of around 110 million guilders has not changed in any respect," IHC added.
The company said in April net profits for the full year were seen rising by some 18 percent, while earnings per share would grow by some 12 percent.
IHC Caland is to issue an updated 1997 profit forecast on August 25 together with its first-half results.
